title: Carolinas Wildfires Response
description: A South Carolina Army National Guard UH-60L Black Hawk medium-lift utility helicopter assigned to 1-111th General Support Aviation Battalion, 59th Aviation Troop Command supports the South Carolina Forestry Commission to contain a remote fire near the top of Pinnacle Mountain in Pickens County, South Carolina, Nov. 17, 2016. The aircraft is equipped with a Bambi Bucket; the bucket can be filled with 6,000lb of water, to be transported and dumped on the fire. (U.S. Army National Guard photo by Staff Sgt. Roberto Di Giovine)
